notes.title: v1.03 Patch
notes.notes:
The following issues have been addressed and fixed as of the current update:

 Fixed option settings: Resolution and Key bindings.
Before starting the game, please delete the previous input.ini file in the folder below. ;
C:\Users\User Name\AppData\Local\Bellatia\Saved\Config\WindowsNoEditor 

 Fixed a quit button in the town: Players can move to the main title by pressing the button.


We apologize for any inconvenience caused. Thank you so much for playing.

notes.title: v1.01 Patch
notes.notes:

 Fixed AI of monsters in the tutorial.
 Fixed lags in the town after completing the tutorial.

 Fixed a crash issue at the 5th stage(Towtool) of Time Attack.

We are continuing to fix more issues in the meantime, we seek your kindest patience in this matter.
